originals.ko: 너는 그거 말할 수 있어
originals.why: Here 'mi fedri di ddeud' is a statement meaning 'you can say', which is natural North Welsh and the same sense as the LEGO. 'o' is rendered 그거 so it stays apart from hynna, which is 그걸 in the seed.
